## Où j'en suis
Branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` adds keyboard move/resize and a focus ring to the Dashboards v2 grid, in PR #423 (open, review requested from Priya). PR #418 is merged. `dashboards_v2` is on for the Zest workspace on staging only; production stays off until the user flips it the morning of the 24th for the Zest demo. (source: ses-db-4, d4-05, d4-06, d4-07, c3-05)

- [en-cours] Priya's review of PR #423 (source: d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging (source: d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Turn `dashboards_v2` on in production the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor alongside react-grid-layout applied each move twice and doubled mouse layout changes, so the library was removed (source: d4-02)
- [question] Whether legacy v1 dashboards are removed on Jan 5, as an agent note says; Priya's instruction was to keep them behind the flag until January (source: src-note-v1, b2-04)
- [décision] ResizeObserver instead of container queries, which iOS 15 ignores (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Keyboard handling written in-house on the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts; the visx migration (PR #401) is closed (source: c3-03)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January (source: b2-04)
